description: BELAY's dependency bot (feature 011, ADR-0004). It proposes and never merges: CI judges every PR and a human merges.
scripts/check-renovate-config.mjs holds this file to contracts C1-C11 (specs/011-renovate-dependency-bot/contracts/renovate-config.md).
Rule ORDER in packageRules is load-bearing: a later rule overrides an earlier one. Read docs/runbooks/renovate.md before editing.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes ignore the window and arrive on the six-hourly cron. The 12-hour cooling-off keeps the worst case near 18h (research R4).

lockFileMaintenance.description: Its preset schedule ('before 4am on monday') would replace the window, so it is set here explicitly (research R2).

logLevelRemap.matchMessage: /did not have a releaseTimestamp, but as we're running with minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-optional/

customManagers.description: Trivy (scripts/install-trivy.mjs). The version and the asset name move together; the sha256 is moved by the post-upgrade task below.
The Rust toolchain: sast-prepare.mjs and the dev-container image name the same version (group 'rust toolchain').
rustup-init (scripts/sast-prepare.mjs). Its sha256 is moved by the post-upgrade task below.
cargo-audit (scripts/sast-prepare.mjs). Its sha256 is moved by the post-upgrade task below.
uv: the dev-container image and the guardrails SAST job install the same pinned release (group 'uv').
Spec Kit: the dev-container CLI and the version the project files were generated by (group 'spec kit', approval on every update).

PowerShell for CI (scripts/install-pwsh.mjs, feature 016). Same dependency as the dev container's, so both move in one PR; the version and the asset name move together, and the sha256 is moved by the post-upgrade task below.
PowerShell, which Spec Kit's scripts need, in the dev-container image.
The bot itself (scripts/check-renovate-config.mjs RENOVATE_VERSION). Its PR's guardrails validator runs the new version against this file first.

packageRules.description: The routine cooling-off: a release is proposed only once it is three days old (research R5).
Slot order: lock files first. Set here, because inside the lockFileMaintenance block prPriority is ignored (research R3).
Lockstep: the FROM node: image and every setup-node node-version move as one (toolchain-consistency rule 4).
Lockstep: nx and every @nx/* (constitution 'Lockstep groups MUST be exact').
Lockstep: the Rust toolchain in sast-prepare.mjs and the dev-container image.
Lockstep: uv in the dev-container image and the guardrails SAST job.

Why: a Spec Kit bump must run `specify integration upgrade`, or the checked-in scripts fall behind the CLI (docs/runbooks/spec-kit.md). Re-check: never; this is the procedure, approve on the dashboard and run the upgrade in the PR.
Digest pins third. After the docker groups on purpose, so a digest update is not swallowed by a version group (MCM's pinDigest collision).
A digest update is aged against a timestamp it often cannot have; without this it stays pending for ever (research R5).
ghcr.io and quay.io publish no tag timestamps the docker datasource can read.
Why: every BELAY dependency is toolchain, and a merge here is a release to consumers (ADR-0004), so every major waits for a tick on the dashboard. Re-check: never; approve on the dashboard.
Why: Forgejo's artifact backend rejects actions/upload-artifact v4 with GHESNotSupportedError (measured in MCM). Tracked in item #62. Re-check: a Forgejo release whose artifact backend accepts v4.

Why: engines.node is the toolchain floor check-toolchain-consistency.mjs rule 1 reads; it is raised by hand when the package manager's own engines rises. Decided in item #47. Re-check: when packageManager's engines.node exceeds the floor.
Why: belay-devcontainer is the image BELAY builds itself; there is no upstream to look up. Decided in item #47. Re-check: never, while devcontainer-image.yml builds it.
The Trivy pair moves together: refresh its sha256 from the release, agreed by the published checksums file (research R7).
The rustup-init pair moves together, agreed by the published .sha256 file.
The pwsh pair moves together, agreed by the release's hashes.sha256 (UTF-16LE; feature 016).
The cargo-audit pair moves together, agreed by the digest GitHub's release API reports.
